reconciliation.1_phase_improved_LM: YES but only at ~2M-param micro-scale as a fluency effect (C4: 72.8 vs 118.3, 3 seeds). No larger-scale Phase PPL exists.
reconciliation.2_phase_long_range_retrieval: NOT DEMONSTRATED; contradicted where tested (C5, C9). Only positive is a synthetic cue probe (C8) that fails to transfer; hybrid needle = 0% (C3).
reconciliation.4_slots_single_fact_recall: YES but fragile, 1/3 seeds, single-fact (C6); slot survival independently validated (C14).
reconciliation.5_slots_relational: NO in the micro-scale ladder (C7); YES only in the deterministic governance study with NO Phase and NO learned model (C15-C16).
reconciliation.6_quad_reader_value: PARTIAL, only in synthetic enterprise study (C15); the decisive Quad-reads-Phase-memory-vs-raw-tokens ablation was NEVER run.
reconciliation.7_phase_decorative: YES, repeatedly, now conceded by authors (C5,C9; falsification 'DECORATIVE'; v3 retires superiority).
reconciliation.8_constant_recurrent_decode: IMPLEMENTATION-DEPENDENT: true for pure/lightweight Phase; FALSE for shipped BindingCacheTransformer / HybridPhaseTransformer with local_layers>0.
reconciliation.9_full_prefix_replay: YES, the shipped hybrid's default decode path (verified firsthand phase_transformer.py:7746-7752).
reconciliation.10_meaningful_scale_training: NO. Every executed result is micro-scale; no committed checkpoints/logs; 7B is a recipe only.
reconciliation.11_multi_seed: YES for 4 studies (3 seeds each) and those are the ones that FALSIFY Phase; the positive slot needle is 1/3 seeds; enterprise pilot seed 0 only.
reconciliation.12_valid_after_fidelity: Valid: (a) Phase micro-scale fluency gain; (b) bounded-state/no-N×N deployment properties of the CLEAN arms; (c) slots (not Phase) carry fragile single-fact recall; (d) Phase adds no retrieval / ablation-neutral; (e) deterministic governance results (no Phase). Invalidated: Protected-Phase superiority / decay-tax narrative; transfer of synthetic needle to language.
reconciliation.13_obsolete_evidence: Reimplemented Phase core (no normalizer) DISCARDED; '6 Phase + 6 Quad' 12-layer model never existed; v1/v2 'HybridPhaseTransformer as product' SUPERSEDED by v3; lightweight C8 superseded for external validity by C9; '35 VALIDATED' matrix obsolete/misleading.
